evidence.quote: I will leave discussion of current policy to today's question-and-answer session and, of course, to my congressional testimony next week.
we are still working to achieve a full recovery from its effects.
by offering guidance about how policy will respond to economic developments, the Committee has been able to increase policy accommodation, even when the short-term interest rate is near zero
The Committee has also sought to influence interest rates further out on the yield curve, notably through its securities purchases.
